summary: Continuous forward camera motion carries the viewer down the initial corridor, passing through a bright portal that creates a whiteout transition, and successfully emerging into the final debris field.
observations: Corridor walls show clear perspective change and parallax as the camera moves forward.
The camera enters the bright vertical portal, resulting in a complete frame whiteout at t=3.00s.
The whiteout acts as a spatial threshold, clearing to reveal the target void environment.
Forward travel continues smoothly through the floating debris in the final frames.
